title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 1+1 + VERANDA+PARKING NEAR THE MORTGAGE!
description_en: Apartment 1+1+Verande+Post parking for sale in Albanopoli street (near Hipotek) with a total area of ​​74m2. It is located on the sixth floor of a building under construction (at the stage of facade and doors and windows). It is organized by a living room and kitchen, a bedroom, a toilet, a corridor, a balcony, a 2.3m2 veranda. A parking post is offered as a condition outside of this value of the apartment. Perfect South orientation offering light and natural heating throughout the day and has a fantastic view of Tirana. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
